neighbours.label: ' how' opening an indirect question of degree or manner after a measuring/reporting verb (shows how much, depends on how many, track how)
fire: A simple scan reveals how much fat is stored around the liver.
The final grade depends on how many assignments a student completes.
Engineers recorded how fast the bridge cables vibrated in strong wind.
The survey asked parents how often their children read before bed.
Researchers monitored how patients responded to the lower dose.
Your credit score reflects how reliably you have repaid past loans.
The app calculates how much water you drink over the day.
Analysts are watching how consumers react to the higher prices.
quiet: A simple scan reveals the amount of fat stored around the liver.
The final grade depends on the number of assignments a student completes.
Engineers recorded the speed at which the bridge cables vibrated in wind.
The survey asked parents about their children's reading before bed.
Researchers monitored the patients' responses to the lower dose.
Your credit score reflects your record of repaying past loans.
The app calculates the volume of water you drink over the day.
Analysts are watching consumer reactions to the higher prices.

notes: Probe: embedded how after shows/depends on/track/measure 0.33-0.55; 'no idea how' 0.13, 'just how it is' 0.07, sentence-initial How 0.19, 'the amount of' 0.04. Near misses paraphrase the clause as a noun phrase.
